limitations: Derived research dataset, not an OCHA or FTS product; OCHA has not reviewed, authorised or endorsed it.

Retrospective research only: launch-time availability, strictly-after-launch label timing, and original-requirements vintages are NOT VERIFIED (no historical publication ledger exists for the FTS record).
The grain is one appeal-plan ID x plan year; (country, plan year) is not unique - 41 country-year groups carry more than one appeal.

The illustrative stock runner (eval AUC 0.6452) trails the persistence reference (0.7171); no headroom is claimed, and the persistence reference holds an information advantage the model is denied by design.
The isolated-rows declaration is a conservative posture, not an enforcement claim: nothing shipped enforces it, and any real evaluation must restrict solver access itself.
37 of 758 rows differ between the flow endpoint's year total and the HDX CSV's funding column; the count is disclosed, not hidden.
The labeled holdout is downloadable by design; keep it outside every evaluated agent's workspace.
Source terms preserved: FTS use-and-republish permission plus CC BY-IGO on the HDX bulk input; our compilation contribution is CC0-1.0 and code MIT.

paragraphs: OCHA's Financial Tracking Service records every coordinated appeal, its original launch requirements, and the funding that follows. The contribution here is not access: it is the pinned FTS/HPC harvest, the declaration that the prediction instant is the appeal's launch, and the label - whether appeal-linked funding reaches at least half of the original requirements by the close of the plan year. One row per appeal-plan ID x plan year (758 rows; a country can carry several distinct appeals in one plan year, and the package says so explicitly). Funding totals themselves never ship.

This release survived two adversarial audits. The first rejected its predecessor: the shipped country-history features let a label-blind attacker reconstruct earlier rows' labels exactly. Those columns are gone - the only history-derived column reads prior appeal YEARS, never labels - and the re-audit's frozen attacks, re-run on these bytes, found no replacement channel in 1,223 probes. The re-audit returned PUBLISH WITH CONDITIONS: describe the grain honestly (done), stay retrospective-only (stated), and keep the model's underperformance visible (kept).

Every number is published beside its references, because the references decide what it means. The illustrative stock runner reaches eval AUC 0.6452 and TRAILS persistence at 0.7171 - an honest negative finding. And the comparison is asymmetric by design: the model is deliberately denied the last prior outcome (the removed leaky feature) while the persistence reference reads it scorer-side. An auditor's untuned logistic fit reached 0.788 on the same rows, so signal beyond the references plausibly exists - but no headroom is claimed under the shipped protocol.

This is retrospective research over a current-vintage record. The FTS API exposes no historical vintages, no row-level launch timestamps or funding-crossing times ship, and no point-in-time or operational forecasting claim is made. The labeled holdout ships by design and stays outside every evaluated agent's workspace.
post.title: Will the appeal reach half its ask? A launch-time task over FTS records

suitability.summary: Retained for retrospective model-development research and agent evaluation with the labeled eval split as development/validation data. Each row is one single-country UN-coordinated appeal-year with a positive launch-vintage original requirements figure; every feature is the appeal's own launch-record attribute, except years_since_country_prior, which reads only WHICH strictly-earlier same-country appeals exist (their years, never any outcome), is derivable from the shipped row set itself, and is asserted label-free by brute-force recompute at construction. The prediction instant is the appeal's public launch (event_time, requirements announcement), months before the plan year closes; the label (year-end funding >= 50% of original requirements) is resolved from the FTS flow endpoint's per-plan-year fundingTotal, which never ships. The 2026.10-era prior-outcome features that allowed exact cross-row label recovery (the 2026-11-01 queue audit recovered 120/139 eval and 128/182 holdout labels through count x rounded-rate arithmetic plus the last-prior tie rule) no longer ship in this version; rows are unchanged vs the audited e7441e1f and every reference reproduced to the last digit after the rebuild. The FTS/HPC API exposes no historical vintages (checked), so training-label timing and full-row historical availability are unverified and none is claimed: this is current-vintage retrospective research under a restricted isolated-rows protocol, never a certified historical-forecasting setup. Measured finding carried beside every figure: on the identical 139 eval rows the stock runner scores 0.6452 while the persistence reference (persistence_last_coverage, recomputed scorer-side from prior-in-time labels because its feature form is exactly the removed P0 channel) scores 0.7171136653895275 - the model trails persistence by 0.0719 and every other measured simple reference except the majority-class rate: no demonstrated headroom under this protocol for the stock runner. The comparison carries an inherent information asymmetry that must travel with the number: the model is deliberately denied the last prior same-country outcome under the operator's P0 standard while the persistence reference reads it scorer-side (train+eval labels only; the holdout is never opened). Any headroom claim requires beating persistence_last_coverage on the same rows.
supported_uses: Retrospective research and method comparison on the pinned 2026-10-29/30 harvest, predicting row-wise from the shipped launch-instant columns under an isolated-rows protocol
Agent evaluation with the labeled eval split as development/validation data and the holdout kept outside agent development until a design is frozen
Study of appeal-level, plan-type and country-level prevalence and of which launch attributes carry outcome signal
Persistence-vs-model comparison research, quoting both figures on the identical rows with the information-asymmetry note
unsupported_uses: Operational or live launch-instant funding screening: no historical operational-availability evidence exists and none is claimed
Point-in-time historical reconstruction: the FTS/HPC API serves a current vintage only; a later re-fetch is a different vintage, not what was knowable at an earlier instant
Quoting the model AUC (0.6452) without the reference comparison (persistence 0.71711) and the information-asymmetry note beside it
Reading the model-vs-persistence gap as model failure against an equal information set: the persistence reference reads a value the model is deliberately denied
Any historical-forecasting certification: a full-row availability ledger and reviewed as-of evidence do not exist for this source

summary: Research task: at a humanitarian appeal's launch, from launch-time facts only - plan type, GHO membership, original requirements, and the gap since the country's prior appeal - predict whether appeal-linked funding will reach at least half of the original launch requirements.
